description: 手机支架（loft 放样底座 + 槽）
description_en: A phone stand with lofted base and phone slot
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
base_w = 80       # 底座宽 (mm)
base_d = 60       # 底座深 (mm)
top_w = 70        # 顶部宽 (mm)
top_d = 15        # 顶部深 (mm)
height = 80       # 支架高度 (mm)
slot_w = 68       # 卡槽宽度 (mm)
slot_d = 10       # 卡槽深度 (mm)
slot_h = 15       # 卡槽高度 (mm)
angle = 15        # 倾斜角度 (度)

# === 底座 loft ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(base_w, base_d)
    .workplane(offset=height)
    .rect(top_w, top_d)
    .loft()
)

# === 手机卡槽 ===
slot = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=height - slot_h)
    .rect(slot_w, slot_d)
    .extrude(slot_h + 10)
)

result = result.cut(slot)

# === 圆角 ===
result = result.edges("|Z").fillet(5)
result = result.edges(">Z").fillet(2)

show_object(result)
